items.source: Create a new SpringApplication.AbandonedRunException instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的SpringApplication.AbandonedRunException 实例。

items.source: Create a new SpringApplication.AbandonedRunException instance with the given application context.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有给定应用上下文的SpringApplication.AbandonedRunException实例。

items.source: Return the application context that was available when the run was abandoned or null if no context was available.
items.translation: 返回在放弃运行时可用的应用程序上下文，或者如果没有可用上下文则返回 null。

items.source: applicationContext - the application context that was available when the run was abandoned
items.translation: applicationContext - 在放弃运行时可用的应用程序上下文

items.source: Exception that can be thrown to silently exit a running SpringApplication without handling run failures.
items.translation: 可抛出以静默退出正在运行的SpringApplication而无需处理运行失败的异常。
